hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'f="$HOME/bin/ctxtra"; if [ -x "$f" ]; then exec "$f" hook devin SessionStart; else /bin/cat >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"ctxtra: the ctxtra binary that this hook runs is missing; reinstall ctxtra, or run ctxtra setup --agent devin with the new binary\"}"; fi'
